data: Tesla's fiscal 2024 results show a business whose top line stalled while profitability weakened sharply. Revenue reached $97.7 billion in fiscal 2024, up only 0.9% from $96.8 billion in fiscal 2023. Net income fell 52.7%, from $15.0 billion in fiscal 2023 to $7.1 billion in fiscal 2024, which points to significant margin pressure over the period. Cash generation was more encouraging. Operating cash flow rose from $13.3 billion in fiscal 2023 to $14.9 billion in fiscal 2024. Cash and cash equivalents were broadly stable, at $16.1 billion in fiscal 2024 against $16.4 billion in fiscal 2023. The balance sheet expanded, with total assets growing from $106.6 billion to $122.1 billion. Total liabilities increased from $43.0 billion to $48.4 billion over the same two years. Overall, liquidity looks solid, but restoring earnings growth remains the central question for investors.
